posts.title: Chery-JLR's Freelander 8 tops 10,000 pre-orders in first 48 hours
posts.summary:
The Freelander 8 opened for pre-sales in China on August 14, with a starting price of 339,900 yuan ($50,080).
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: The Freelander 8, a luxury extended-range SUV from the Chery-JLR joint venture, secured over 10,000 pre-orders within 48 hours of its August 14 launch.
Pricing for the five variants ranges from 339,900 yuan ($50,080) to 459,900 yuan, targeting the premium segment with high-performance specs including 610 kW of power.
The vehicle features advanced technology integration, including Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5 and the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8397 chip, which provides 320 TOPS of computing power.
Built on an 800-volt 6C platform, the SUV utilizes a 60.3 kWh CATL battery capable of charging from 20% to 80% in 12 minutes.

posts.summary:

For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).

- Tesla delivered 27,249 vehicles in China in July, down 32.91% year-on-year.
Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) saw its China deliveries fall almost 33% year-on-year in July, while exports from its Shanghai plant hit a record high.
The contrast underscores how the company's China operations are becoming more reliant on overseas markets.
Tesla delivered 27,249 vehicles in China in July, down 32.91% year-on-year and 48.51% from June, according to CnEVPost calculations based on data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA).

posts.title: Automakers' share of China NEV exports in July: BYD leads with 32.2%, Tesla rises to No. 3 with 12.3%
posts.summary:
BYD continued to dominate China's NEV export market in July with 173,721 vehicles, while Tesla China exported 66,330 units.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD maintained its lead in China's NEV exports for July with 173,721 units, capturing a 32.2% market share.
Tesla China experienced a significant surge in export volume, rising to third place with 66,330 units, a 143.2% increase year-on-year.
Chery and Geely remain key players in the export market, with Chery leading the overall passenger vehicle export category at a 21.7% share.

posts.title: GAC Aion to debut Ray 7, first model in Ray lineup, on August 19
posts.summary:
Ray 7 is powered by a 180-kW motor supplied by Huawei and emphasizes sporty handling.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: GAC Aion will debut the Ray 7 on August 19, a mid-to-large-size electric sedan designed to capture the younger demographic and spearhead a new product lineup.
The vehicle is powered by a 180-kW Huawei-supplied motor and utilizes LFP batteries sourced from both CATL and GAC Aion's subsidiary, Yinpai Battery.
The Ray 7 introduces GAC Aion's new brand logo and features a 'Super Chassis' with chip-level drive-control integration, alongside an optional LiDAR-based driver-assistance system.
This launch follows a strong recovery for GAC Aion, which reported a 62.08% year-on-year sales increase for the first seven months of 2026.

posts.title: From Tokens To Tasks: Why Agentic AI Changes The Infrastructure Conversation
posts.summary:
As AI moves from answering prompts to completing work, infrastructure has to optimize the full workflow around the model.
The post From Tokens To Tasks: Why Agentic AI Changes The Infrastructure Conversation appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The shift from prompt-based AI to agentic AI requires infrastructure to support complex, multi-step workflows rather than simple token generation.
Agentic AI demands higher reliability and tighter integration between compute, memory, and networking to handle autonomous decision-making cycles.
Infrastructure providers must now optimize for the entire task lifecycle, including the orchestration of fragmented tool ecosystems and continuous verification.
